summarizer.title: Reading-time summarizer
summarizer.goal: Build a small standard-library Python reading-time summarizer. Read readings.csv and create summarize.py that writes summary.json with total_minutes and minutes_by_topic. Include a brief USAGE.md. Verify the real script against the supplied fixture. Keep the code simple, use the project files, and deliver verified outputs. Also output entry_count.
summarizer.acceptance: Running the script produces total_minutes=50 and minutes_by_topic Agents=35, Storage=15; the usage guide explains the command. entry_count must equal 3.

messages.body: Additional user direction: summary.json must also include entry_count=3. Verify this additional output and document it.
